questions: Q1 How much does short-term zone imbalance cost Zone (vs the same system with balanced load)?
Q2 How much of that gap does Silica-style work stealing recover?
Q3 Where does work stealing fall short at small scale (reaction to moving hotspots, extra travel, tuning, shuttle count)?
drop_rule: If best-tuned Zone + work stealing is within ~10% of the balanced reference p99 at hot shares <= 47%, the motivation is not supported.
notes: Zone + work stealing only; Non-Zone is deliberately excluded from this round.
hot_share = share of requests on one rack row; 0.125 = uniform. 0.47 = Azure trace P95 busiest-zone share over 100-request windows.
Balanced reference = Zone at the same N, rate and congestion cost under uniform load.
Arrival rate = offered_load x closed-batch throughput of balanced Zone at that N and congestion cost.
Work stealing reconstructed from Silica SOSP'23 Sec. 4; all variants run, best per cell reported. Helper cap is effectively min(H, N-1).
Primary congestion cost 0.5 s; 0 s kept as sensitivity. Finite 2400-request episodes, not steady state.
